description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange from 03.05.2021 to 09.05.2021
categorisation: This gazette content is a Customs Notification that establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It exercises regulatory powers under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) to determine currency conversion rates, which falls under legal/regulatory matters. While it names the Director General of Customs, this is in an official regulatory capacity rather than a personnel appointment, and the content focuses on establishing legal rates rather than government structure or personnel changes.
